description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithLocationId' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to retrieve and format location names based on location IDs, utilizing the 'LocationService' to fetch 'Location' entities.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationId
classes.description: A class that formats location IDs into location names using a LocationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the location name corresponding to a given location ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocationService, initializing it if necessary.
